message:
Fix number_format() to deal with very large precisions/very large numbers

Summary: Max output width of number_format() was constrained to 64 characters
which isn't necessarily the case with double-precision floating point
numbers which can go out to a few hundred decimal places.

Also fixed php_math_round() implementation to use doubles all the way
through rather than single-precision float for `f1`.

Closes #4202
